text:
Gabe: Quick poll for Armans bday next Tue  2 options: LED tealight jar (photo-friendly, no flames) or curated snack box (local treats, maybe allergen issues)?
Lucia: LED jar 31f looks cute on desks and totally ship-safe.
Tanya: Snack box if we want a little variety. Also could include a handwritten note.
people-ops-bot: :ballot_box: Poll started  led_jar 1, snack_box 1
Ethan: Heads-up: office rules forbid open flames and aerosol confetti, but battery LEDs are fine. Also shipping estimate: LED jars $12 each + $5 shipping; snack boxes $20 + $8 shipping.
Mona: LED jar wins for budget. Also less worry about "no-nuts" labels.
Gabe: We have $140 in the birthday fund. Remotes=6. LED jar fits the budget and is low-effort.
Lucia: If LED, can we add a Spotify playlist link in the card? Arman loves 80s synths.
Tanya: love the playlist idea. I'll make a short 6-track list.
people-ops-bot: :memo: Reminder created: "Order 7 LED jars + make playlist" scheduled for 1943225000.
Ethan: I'll take care of order + shipping labels. Please DM me addresses by Thu EOD.
Mona: Also, can we add a small sticker that says "Happy Bday Arman"? EU customs sometimes flag branded swag, so make a plain label for EU recipients.
Gabe: Noted. EU-friendly labels and "no nuts" on all snack alternatives.
Lucia: I can do the playlist + digital card. Link will be posted here when ready.
Tanya: Optional micro-fund for a nicer jar: $3 per person. Chip in if you want (Venmo @redwood-bday).
people-ops-bot: :tada: Final plan: LED jars + playlist, budget_est=$140, remotes=6, owners=[Ethan,Lucia]. Thread closed.
Ethan: Thanks folks! I'll post the DM for addresses in an hour.
Mona: Yay 389 thanks team!
